verdict.description: request_changes if any finding is a blocker; comment if any is should_fix; otherwise approve.

summary_md.description: Two to six sentences of Markdown: what the change does and the overall risk. No headings.

findings.description: Every finding, including the ones also posted as inline comments. Empty when there is nothing to report.

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file; 0 when the finding is about the file as a whole.

detail.description: Why it is wrong, the concrete failure it causes, and the fix. Markdown, short.

reviewed_sha.description: The head commit SHA that was reviewed, copied from the PR context.
